remarks: Spacious modern 3-storey duplex offering flexibility, comfort & bright open-concept living w/ main-level bdrm. Ground flr features garage access, private bdrm & full 3-pce bath, ideal for guests, office or multi-gen living. Brushed nickel hardware adds a contemporary touch.   Second level offers 9' ceilings, LVP flooring thru main living areas and open great rm, nook & kitchen filled w/ natural light, plus private outdoor patio for relaxing or entertaining. Convenient 2-pce bath off kitchen. Upgraded kitchen features quartz counters, peninsula w/ flush eating ledge & pendant lighting, Silgranit undermount sink w/ upgraded spot-resistant SS faucet, chimney-style hood fan w/ full-height tile backsplash, Thermofoil cabinets w/ soft-close doors/drawers, corner pantry & built-in microwave in lower cabinetry. Coordinated black plumbing/lighting pkg adds modern style.   Third flr offers 2 primary bdrms, each w/ 3-pce ensuite w/ tub/shower combo, lrg windows & thoughtful closet space, plus dedicated laundry area. (id:67522)
